quotes: We are continuing to see an improved spending environment from our client base, principally within our DSA segment, as the demand conditions have improved from levels experienced in the recent quarters, due primarily to increased biotech funding and global biopharmaceutical companies refocusing their investments on their early-stage research and development pipelines.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the Q3 release; the counter is stated in the 10-K MD&A.
growth_thesis.claim: Manufacturing Solutions is a second organic growth driver: its organic revenue rose 7.4%, driven by demand in Biologics Testing Solutions and Microbial Solutions. Continued growth requires that quality-control testing demand stays strong.
quotes: Organic revenue increased 7.4%, driven by strong demand in both the Biologics Testing Solutions and Microbial Solutions businesses.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the earnings release; the 0.6% RMS figure is in the same item.
growth_thesis.claim: Reported revenue is shrinking while organic revenue grows because of divestitures. Third-quarter revenue fell 2.2% reported but rose 4.7% organic, and guidance is for organic growth of at least +1.5%. Growth therefore depends on the retained businesses outgrowing the lost revenue.
quotes: On an organic basis, revenue increased 4.7%, driven by revenue growth in the Manufacturing Solutions (Manufacturing) and Discovery and Safety Assessment (DSA) segments.

growth_thesis.basis: Drivers are stated in the release; that the divestiture effect is one-time is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Margin expansion is an earnings growth driver. Non-GAAP operating margin rose to 23.0% from 19.7%, helped by the CDMO divestiture and operating leverage on safety assessment volume. The divestiture benefit is a one-time level shift, so continued margin growth needs volume to keep rising.
quotes: primarily as a result of the benefit of the CDMO divestiture and operating leverage from higher sales volume for safety assessment services

growth_thesis.basis: Stated by management in the 10-Q; the realization risk is stated in the 10-K risk factors.
growth_thesis.claim: Cost-savings programs are expected to add earnings: about $300 million of cumulative annualized savings by the end of 2026, then incremental savings in excess of $300 million between 2027 and 2030 under Create the Future. The savings must actually be realized.
quotes: In addition, the Create the Future program is expected to generate incremental cost savings in excess of $300 million between 2027 and 2030.

growth_thesis.basis: The cost effect is stated; the causal link to the acquisition is inferred from the two facts appearing together.
growth_thesis.claim: Lower sourcing costs for large research models helped DSA's non-GAAP margin rise to 26.8% from 25.4%. The company acquired a Cambodian non-human primate supplier at a preliminary purchase price of $507.3 million. The link between the acquisition and the lower sourcing costs is inferred, and continued benefit requires secure NHP supply.
quotes: as well as lower sourcing costs for large research models

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the release and the income statement; the share-count effect is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Per-share earnings growth is also supported by a lower tax rate and a lower share count. Non-GAAP EPS was $3.09, up 27.2%, driven by higher operating margin and a lower tax rate. GAAP EPS of $6.86 includes a one-time $5.06 benefit from reversing tax reserves, so it is not a run-rate.
quotes: The non-GAAP net income and earnings per share increases were driven primarily by the higher operating margin and a lower tax rate.

growth_thesis.basis: Figures are stated in the statements; the funding interpretation is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Growth is being funded with cash and debt, and this needs continued financing capacity. Nine-month operating cash flow was 474,887 (table in thousands) versus 590,126, long-term debt rose to 2,443,461 from 2,136,360, and 324,105 went to treasury stock purchases.

material_events.claim: The company sold its CDMO and Cell Solutions businesses to GI Partners, with net cash paid to the buyer of $12.4 million. It recognized a pre-tax loss on divestiture of $181.7 million for the nine months.
quotes: On May 6, 2026, we sold our CDMO and Cell Solutions businesses (CDMO and Cell Solutions Divestiture) to GI Partners (GI) for net cash paid to the buyer of $12.4 million, net of costs to sell and subject to certain customary closing adjustments.
We recognized the pre-tax loss on divestiture of $181.7 million for the nine months ended September 26, 2026 within Other expense, net on the unaudited condensed consolidated statements of income.

material_events.claim: The company sold certain European Discovery Services businesses to IQVIA for a purchase price of $126.4 million in cash.
quotes: On May 22, 2026, we sold certain European Discovery Services businesses (European Discovery Divestiture) to IQVIA Inc. (IQVIA) for a purchase price of $126.4 million in cash, net of costs to sell and subject to certain customary closing adjustments.

material_events.basis: stated in the cited item; the price is given in the same 10-Q section
material_events.claim: The company completed the acquisition of certain assets of K.F. Cambodia Ltd, a Cambodian non-human primate supplier. The preliminary purchase price was $507.3 million.
quotes: On January 14, 2026, we completed the acquisition of certain assets of K.F. Cambodia Ltd (Cambodian NHP Supplier), a leading supplier of non-human primates (NHPs) located in Cambodia.

material_events.claim: The company completed the acquisition of an additional 79% equity interest in PathoQuest SAS for $67.4 million.
quotes: On April 17, 2026, we completed the acquisition of an additional 79% equity interest in PathoQuest SAS (PathoQuest), for $67.4 million.

material_events.claim: The company announced its Create the Future program, which formalizes and expands its transformation and efficiency initiatives.
quotes: During the third quarter of fiscal 2026, we announced our Create the Future program, which formalizes and expands the Company’s ongoing transformation and efficiency initiatives under a unified operating framework.

material_events.basis: stated in the cited item; F3 shows the matching cash flow adjustment
material_events.claim: Third-quarter GAAP results included a benefit of $245.6 million, or $5.06 per share, from reversing acquired tax reserves after newly enacted tax legislation.
quotes: The GAAP net income and earnings per share increases included a benefit totaling $245.6 million, or $5.06 per share, associated with the reversal of acquired tax reserves following newly enacted tax legislation and completion of certain tax requirements in a foreign jurisdiction.

material_events.claim: The company announced increased full-year revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share guidance in its third-quarter release.
quotes: Increases 2026 guidance for revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share.

material_events.claim: The company recorded a goodwill impairment charge of $165.0 million for the Biologics Solutions reporting unit.
quotes: During the fourth quarter ended December 27, 2025, we performed the quantitative goodwill impairment test for our reporting units and upon completion, it was determined that the fair value of the Biologics Solutions reporting unit did not exceed its carrying value, resulting in a goodwill impairment charge of $165.0 million.

material_events.claim: The SEC Division of Enforcement notified the company that it concluded its investigation and does not intend to recommend an enforcement action.
quotes: On November 14, 2025, the SEC’s Division of Enforcement (Division) notified us that it concluded its investigation and, based on the information available to the Division, it does not intend to recommend an enforcement action by the SEC against the Company.

risks.basis: Figures are stated in the balance sheet and cash flow statement. The risk mechanism is inferred, and the debt risk factor is listed in the 10-K summary.
risks.claim: Long-term debt, net and finance leases rose to 2,443,461 from 2,136,360 (table in thousands), cash was 200,381, and nine-month operating cash flow of 474,887 was below 590,126 a year earlier.
quotes: Our debt level could adversely affect our business and growth prospects.

risks.basis: Stated in the earnings release and the cash flow statement, which shows the reversal of 245,638 (table in thousands). The interpretation is inferred.
risks.claim: Third-quarter GAAP diluted EPS of $6.86 was far above non-GAAP EPS of $3.09 because of a one-time tax reserve reversal worth $245.6 million, or $5.06 per share, so headline GAAP earnings do not reflect a repeatable level.
quotes: The GAAP net income and earnings per share increases included a benefit totaling $245.6 million, or $5.06 per share, associated with the reversal of acquired tax reserves following newly enacted tax legislation and completion of certain tax requirements in a foreign jurisdiction.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the earnings release. The weakness mechanism is inferred.
risks.claim: The demand recovery is still modest: DSA backlog rose only slightly to $2.0 billion from $1.9 billion, reported revenue fell 2.2%, and RMS organic revenue decreased 0.6%.
quotes: DSA backlog increased slightly to $2.0 billion as of September 26, 2026 from $1.9 billion as of December 27, 2025.
Organic revenue decreased by 0.6%, due primarily to lower revenue for small research models in North America and for large research models.

risks.basis: The impairment and warning are stated in the 10-K MD&A. The goodwill balance is stated in the 10-Q balance sheet. The current exposure is inferred.
risks.claim: Goodwill of 3,084,112 (table in thousands) remains large after a $165.0 million Biologics Solutions goodwill impairment in the 2025 annual test, and the 10-K warned of further impairment if cash flows fall short.
quotes: We will continue to closely monitor future performance and any potential impacts on the value of the reporting unit.

risks.basis: Targets and the caution are stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the 10-K risk factors. The shortfall risk is inferred.
risks.claim: Margin gains depend on delivering about $300 million of cumulative annualized savings by the end of 2026 and further savings above $300 million from 2027 to 2030, and the company states these are based on assumptions that may prove inaccurate.
quotes: there can be no assurance that we will realize these profits and cost savings or that, if realized, these profits and cost savings will be sustained.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors and MD&A. The ongoing exposure is inferred from the pending lawsuits and supply concentration.
risks.claim: Non-human primate supply remains a stated dependency and litigation exposure, even though the DOJ and SEC investigations into the NHP supply chain have concluded.
quotes: Several of our product and service offerings, including our non-human primate supply, are dependent on a limited source of supply that, when interrupted, adversely affects our business.

On November 14, 2025, the SEC’s Division of Enforcement (Division) notified us that it concluded its investigation and, based on the information available to the Division, it does not intend to recommend an enforcement action by the SEC against the Company.

a better-than-expected performance in the DSA segment and a lower tax rate
